_description: Block component spec — cluster #10 (CDEP-1949). Surface-only component with no surface states. Two mode-variants (primary/secondary) and a nested-block alternation pattern.
_figmaBranch: BRANCH:block-accordion-10 — key in cluster-roadmap.md (private work repo); TRATON Component Library, node-id=13675-6217
_notes: Block is surface-only. Children own their own text bindings; the Block frame has no text fill in Figma. No component/block/text/* token is specified.

Nested-even / nested-odd are first-class Figma alias variables of primary/secondary because the alternation pattern is real on the design side. Designers can bind these directly on alternating layers within a Block instance.

The Block COMPONENT_SET (13675:6219) exposes a `Nested` BOOLEAN component property (default false) alongside the Mode variant axis. Nested is a per-instance toggle, not a variant — keeps the variant matrix at 2 instead of 4. The nested-even / nested-odd background tokens are intended to be bound on layers gated by `Nested = true`.
_divergence: Naming: Block uses background/primary and background/secondary (no -default suffix). Block is a surface-only component with no surface-state model — primary/secondary is an option/mode-variant axis. Card spec uses background/primary-default / background/secondary-default because Card is interactive and has at least default + hover states; the -default suffix marks the rest position in a state set, which is correct for Card. Different shapes for different reasons. Both are correct in their own component context.

variables.name: component/block/background/primary
variables.comment: Primary mode-variant. Matches Figma live binding on Mode=Primary frame.

variables.name: component/block/background/secondary
variables.comment: Secondary mode-variant. Matches Figma live binding on Mode=Secondary frame.

variables.name: component/block/background/nested-even
variables.comment: Alias of background/primary. Used on even-position layers in nested-block stacks. The 'nested-' prefix disambiguates the alternation context — these tokens belong to the nesting model, not generic surface choice.

variables.name: component/block/background/nested-odd
variables.comment: Alias of background/secondary. Used on odd-position layers in nested-block stacks.

variables.name: component/block/border/radius-default
variables.comment: Both primitives verified to exist in the Primitive collection (FLOAT, value 4). Candidate for promotion to a shared border/radius/sm semantic if/when foundation work lands.

variables.name: component/block/border/radius-none
variables.comment: Forward-compat headroom for a future 'rounded off' variant or component property. Not actively bound today — brands can already set radius-default to 0 if needed. Aliases the unit/0 brand primitives. Matches -input.json radius-none precedent. Aligned with developer (Charles), 2026-05-05.

_parked.reason: Hardcoded 16px in design intent. No spacing-token foundation exists for any cluster yet. Revisit when CDEP-2019/2020 (foundation spacing) lands.
Block is surface-only; the Figma frame has no text fill. Children own text bindings.
Figma has no distinct nested-deeper variant; multi-level nesting alternates between nested-even and nested-odd. If design later adds a third surface tone for level-3+ blocks, revisit.
